description: bbs-website doctrine: before a subscribed skill runs, inject the BBS storefront doctrine or the catalog doctrine as context. Subscriptions and text live in hooks/doctrine/; the script re-keys nothing. PowerShell (pwsh 7 if present, else Windows PowerShell 5.1), selected by the shell Claude Code runs hooks through (Git Bash on Windows, sh on macOS). Fails open: never blocks a skill.

hooks.command: command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/doctrine.ps1"; command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/doctrine.ps1"; exit 0
